description: The first (or a full) deployment of a project into the person's cloud, once a hosting plan is selected. Without confirm it changes nothing and answers with the plan and its monthly cost: tell the person and wait for their yes. Then call again with confirm=true. It creates resources their cloud provider bills them for. Takes 5 to 20 minutes; follow it with deployment. Needs a key with Operate access.

confirm.description: true only after the person said yes to the plan and cost

confirm_cost.description: true only if launch said the plan is above the cost ceiling and the person agreed

project.description: The project's id, name or repository (owner/name).

workspace.description: Act in a teammate's workspace: its id from account. Default: your own.

name: launch
title: Launch a project
